results.market_title: Will CDU win between 8% and 11% of all valid second votes?
results.reasoning: Recent September 2026 polling (Forsa for Ostsee-Zeitung, published Sept 2, 2026) puts CDU at 10%, consistent with a June poll also showing 10%. This falls squarely within the 8-11% bracket. However, other polling sources cited earlier in 2026 showed CDU around 19%, indicating volatility across pollsters/methodologies, and CDU actually scored 13.3% in the 2021 election, so there's meaningful risk the final result lands above 11% or below 8%.
results.key_findings: ["t-online.de: Forsa poll (published Sept 2, 2026) shows CDU at 10%, unchanged from June 2026 poll","2021 election result: CDU won 13.3% (Wikipedia)","Statista/NDR poll from Oct 2024 showed CDU at 19%, showing large swings across the campaign period","AfD leads polling around 37%, SPD around 28%, squeezing CDU into single digits/low double digits per most recent survey","Multiple polls in 2026 (June and Sept) converge on CDU ~10%, suggesting a stabilizing trend within the target bracket"]

results.market_title: Will United Russia (ER) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
results.reasoning: United Russia dominates the electoral system with structural advantages (state control, media, controlled candidate registration, three-day voting) and consistently leads all polling (33-43% vs opposition parties in single digits to mid-teens), holding a supermajority of ~310-324 seats heading into the September 18-20, 2026 election. Multiple sources including Wikipedia, Grokipedia, and Polymarket commentary confirm no realistic scenario where another party surpasses United Russia in seats, given the tightly managed, non-competitive nature of Russian elections.
results.key_findings: ["Wikipedia: United Russia holds ~310-324 of 450 seats going into the 2026 election, next closest party (CPRF) has only 56-57","Grokipedia: State and independent polls (VCIOM, FOM, Levada) show United Russia leading with 33.5%-43% support, far ahead of CPRF (~10-15%)","NEST Centre analysis: 'There is no doubt that the ruling party, United Russia... will retain its constitutional majority'","Election scheduled for 18-20 September 2026; opposition faces registration barriers and a tightly controlled political environment (Polymarket market description)"]
